purpose: Business interpretation layer for recurrent MPSTATS metrics. This file intentionally separates provider labels from independently verified units/definitions.

evidence_levels.live_shape: Field/path observed in a live MPSTATS response; value discarded.
evidence_levels.live_description: Meaning stated by the live MCP tool description.
evidence_levels.inferred_name_only: Only the field name suggests meaning; never sufficient for automated calculations.

global_rules: Never invent currency, VAT basis, gross/net basis, order-vs-sale basis, or percent scaling.
A field named revenue/sales/orders does not by itself establish accounting recognition or marketplace payout semantics.
For percentage-like fields, preserve the raw provider number until the scale is verified (for example 12 vs 0.12).
For money-like fields, keep source/currency metadata separate; do not sum across marketplaces or currencies unless explicitly verified compatible.
For current/prev/diff groups, diff is provider-computed unless independently recalculated and validated.
MPSTATS self_redemption is a provider-side analytics filter; company self-purchase classification remains canonical in v_self_purchase.

revenue.business_meaning: Provider monetary turnover/revenue-style aggregate for the selected analytical scope.
revenue.safe_use: Compare within the same MPSTATS report/scope/period when field definition is unchanged; label as MPSTATS revenue/turnover, not realized payout.
unsafe_use: Do not call it net profit.
Do not treat it as marketplace payout.
Do not merge with direct cabinet revenue without reconciliation.

sales.business_meaning: Provider sales-count style metric for external market/category analytics.
sales.safe_use: Relative comparison inside the same external analytical report.
unsafe_use: Do not assume customer orders, shipped units, or paid/redemption-complete units until verified.

views.business_meaning: Display/impression-style count in the provider report context.
views.safe_use: Use as provider-reported exposure count in the same report context.
unsafe_use: Do not compare across tools that may use different exposure definitions without validation.

clicks.safe_use: Advertising traffic comparison inside MPSTATS bidder reports.

ctr.formula: conceptually clicks/views; exact provider scale/rounding not yet validated
ctr.safe_use: Preserve raw provider value and label as MPSTATS CTR.
unsafe_use: Do not divide or multiply by 100 automatically until scale is verified.

drr.business_meaning: Advertising-cost-to-order/revenue ratio used by MPSTATS/WB advertising analytics.
drr.safe_use: Compare raw MPSTATS DRR within the same bidder report and period.
unsafe_use: Do not infer exact formula denominator or percent scale until independently verified.

orders.business_meaning: Provider order-count metric in the report context.
unsafe_use: Do not equate automatically with paid sales, customer baskets, or units.

orders_sum.business_meaning: Provider monetary order-sum metric associated with advertising analytics.
orders_sum.safe_use: Compare within MPSTATS bidder reports; preserve provider label.
unsafe_use: Do not call it realized revenue or payout.

spending.safe_use: Use as MPSTATS-reported ad spend within the same report/period.
unsafe_use: Do not combine with direct WB expense ledger without reconciliation.

current_prev_diff_status.business_meaning: Provider comparison tuple: current period value, previous period value, provider-computed difference and qualitative status.
current_prev_diff_status.safe_use: Read together with the report period.from/period.to and parent metric.
unsafe_use: Do not interpret diff as percent vs absolute without validating that specific parent metric/tool.

avg_price.business_meaning: Provider average price metric for the selected market scope.
avg_price.safe_use: Relative price-position analysis after confirming report currency/context.
unsafe_use: Do not treat as buyer final price or own seller price.

median_price.business_meaning: Provider median price metric for the selected market scope.
unsafe_use: Do not assume seller-discount/final-payment semantics.

turnover_in_days.business_meaning: Provider inventory turnover duration indicator expressed by its tool description as days.
turnover_in_days.safe_use: Use as MPSTATS turnover-days indicator for niche comparison.
unsafe_use: Do not substitute for internal days-of-stock without formula reconciliation.

revenue_potential.safe_use: Ranking/relative opportunity analysis only until formula and unit are validated.
unsafe_use: Do not present as forecasted guaranteed revenue.

lost_profit.business_meaning: MPSTATS lost-profit/opportunity metric for the subject.
lost_profit.safe_use: Use only as MPSTATS provider metric with caveat.
unsafe_use: Do not book/account it as actual financial loss.

avg_rating.business_meaning: Average product/rating indicator for the analytical scope.
unsafe_use: Do not assume 5-point scale without observing/validating values.

open_card_count.business_meaning: Count-style card-opening metric described by the MPSTATS subject tool.
open_card_count.safe_use: Funnel comparison within the same MPSTATS subject report.
unsafe_use: Do not infer unique users vs events until verified.

add_to_cart_percent.safe_use: Relative funnel comparison, preserving raw provider scale.
unsafe_use: Do not automatically divide/multiply by 100.

cart_to_order_percent.safe_use: Relative funnel comparison, preserving raw provider scale.
unsafe_use: Do not automatically divide/multiply by 100.

seasonality.safe_use: Use only with the exact report and period granularity.
unsafe_use: Do not assume a universal multiplier or percent representation.
